top_signals.title: Massive Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot worldwide
top_signals.summary: Microsoft is investigating a widespread outage affecting multiple Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, as users report connectivity problems worldwide. [...]
